whatsappMessage:
Hi Team My Kitchen,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.5★ reviews in Kidwaipuri, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page for food lovers in Patna.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, special menu showcase, aur instant table booking integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://patna-foodlovers.preview.emergentagent.com/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Team My Kitchen, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (My Kitchen) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering and a showcase of your authentic menu right in Kidwaipuri. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
